lines: Ankur Aggarwal, Promoter Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 3,702,694 Equity Shares in the offer for sale.
Listing is scheduled for On or about Thursday, November 26, 2026 per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
They retain at least 11,062,864 shares if all offered shares sell, and are linked to Ankur Aggarwal KNK Family Trust.
Proceeds and gain are unknown: no confirmed offer price or price band has been set.
